    if (str.Contains(rules, ",")) {

            return sprintf(`(%v)`, str.ReplaceAll(str.TrimSpace(i), ".", `\.`))
        }), "|")

        "cve": cve,
        "rule": rules,
        "score": score,
        "severity": severity,
        "titleZh": titleZh,
        "titleEn": titleEn, 
    })
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen() {
        return
    }

    if result.Fingerprint == nil {
        return
    }
    if str.MatchAllOfRegexp(result.GetServiceName(),"(?i)MailEnable") {
    yakit.Info("cves: %d", len(CVEs))

        x.Foreach(CVEs, func(i) {
            defer func{
                err = recover()
                if err != nil {

                }

            }

            risk.NewRisk(

                risk.typeVerbose("CVE基线检查"),

                risk.potential(true),
                risk.level("low"),
                risk.details(i),
                risk.cve(i.cve),

            println(i.cve)
